remotes.description: List of Git sources for r10k to deploy from. Each item in the list must be an object with 'name', 'remote', and 'basedir' fields defined in the items schema below.

targets.description: List of local directories where r10k will deploy the code. Each item in the list must be an object with 'name' and 'path' fields defined in the items schema below.

purge.description: Whether to delete environment and module directories that are not present in the Puppetfile or Puppetfile repository.

owner.description: The username to chown the deployed files and directories to.

group.description: The group name to chown the deployed files and directories to.
